searches.answer: According to the sources, the trending programming languages in 2025 include Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, and C#. JavaScript remains the backbone of the web ecosystem. Java stays relevant in enterprise applications and backend systems. C# also maintains its dominance. However, there is some mention of Rust and Swift increasing in popularity. The TIOBE Index lists Python as the top language, followed by C, C++, Java, and C#.
